title: Ron Jeremy
wiki_lead:
Ronald Jeremy Hyatt (born March 12, 1953) is an American former pornographic actor. Nicknamed "The Hedgehog", he was ranked by AVN at No. 1 in their "50 Top Porn Stars of All Time" list. He has also made a number of non-pornographic media appearances, and director Scott J. Gill filmed a documentary about him and his legacy, Porn Star: The Legend of Ron Jeremy, released in 2001.
Jeremy was accused of sexual assault more than a dozen times between 2017 and 2020, for incidents stretching back to 2004. Upon further investigation, in August 2021, he was indicted on 30 sexual-assault counts involving 21 victims including 12 counts of forcible rape. He was initially jailed awaiting trial, but in January 2023, a judge found him mentally unfit to stand trial due to "incurable neurocognitive decline"; he was released to a private residence in November 2023.

Early life
Ronald Jeremy Hyatt was born in Queens, New York City, to a middle-class Jewish family from Russia and Poland. His father, Arnold (born 1918), was a physicist and professor at Queens College, CUNY, and his mother a book editor who had served in the O.S.S. during World War II, as she spoke fluent German and French.
Jeremy graduated from Benjamin N. Cardozo High School. After high school, he attended Queens College (part of the City University of New York), where he majored in theater and education as an undergraduate and completed a master's degree.


Pornography career

Jeremy left the teaching profession (he called it his "ace in the hole") to pursue a legitimate acting career on Broadway. He said that he learned then what it was like to be broke, making no money as an actor who "starved Off-Broadway". He soon found work posing for Playgirl after his then-girlfriend submitted his photo to the magazine. He utilized this opportunity as a springboard into the adult film industry, which he viewed as a reliable means of supporting himself. Initially using his surname Hyatt, he later changed to using his middle name Jeremy as his professional name, as his grandmother Rose (listed in the telephone directory as R Hyatt) was receiving nuisance phone calls after the Playgirl spread was published.
Jeremy had the nickname "The Hedgehog" bestowed upon him by fellow porn actor William Margold in 1979 after a situation on the set of the porn film Olympic Fever. Jeremy flew in from New York to shoot the movie. Expecting warm California weather, he wore only a T-shirt and shorts and brought no additional clothing. Upon arriving at the set, Jeremy was immediately whisked away to thaw out in a hot shower. When he finished, his skin had taken on a pinkish hue from the temperature extremes, and all the many hairs on his body were standing on end. grok_lead: Ronald Jeremy Hyatt (born March 12, 1953), known professionally as Ron Jeremy and nicknamed "The Hedgehog," is an American former adult film actor, director, and producer who entered the pornography industry in 1979 and appeared in hundreds of explicit videos. Jeremy gained prominence for his prolific output, earning induction into the AVN Hall of Fame and recognition as a crossover figure with appearances in mainstream media, comedy, and non-adult films. His career spanned decades, during which he also engaged in public speaking, authoring, and industry advocacy, often defending adult entertainment against censorship efforts. In 2021, Jeremy faced criminal charges involving over 30 counts of rape and sexual assault from more than 20 accusers spanning two decades, leading to his arrest and pretrial detention. In 2023, a Los Angeles judge ruled him mentally incompetent to stand trial due to incurable neurocognitive decline, halting proceedings and resulting in his release to a private residence under supervision. Civil lawsuits related to alleged assaults at venues like the Rainbow Bar & Grill have seen settlements as recently as 2025, though Jeremy denies the accusations.
